"U.N.I.T.Y." is a song by American hip-hop artist Queen Latifah from her third studio album, Black Reign (1993).

The single was released by Motown on November 9, 1993, in the United States, and on January 6, 1994, in the United Kingdom.

"U.N.I.T.Y." focused on confronting disrespect of women in society, addressing issues of street harassment, domestic violence, and slurs against women in hip-hop culture.
